candidates.detail: The public clothing module exposes ClothingShell and its public faces, positions, normals and specification. ClothingShell::refit checks only the incoming position and normal counts against self.positions before it calls fitted_surface. That helper first calls relax_concavities, which indexes a neighbors vector by each face vertex, and only afterwards would refit call validated_placeholder_faces, whose OutOfRangeFace error retains the offending triangle. For a public shell with three positions and face [0, 1, 3], together with three incoming positions and normals, the count guard passes and the second edge attempts neighbors[3] in a three-element vector before the intended bounds error. This follows from source control flow and indexing; no constructor, call or panic was executed.
candidates.consumer_and_safeguards: The normal generate_clothing_shells entry rejects source face indices outside the body vertex count and returns selected source faces; the character export obtains its clothing shells from that generator and refits them for morph samples. No supported generated shell with invalid faces or real export failure is established. A Rust caller can directly construct or alter the public fields, so the public refit route does not itself retain that generator safeguard.
